_comment: Bubble Reef Rush asset manifest. Each entry: path = res:// path, fallback = res:// path (always present stub), spec = plain-text drop-in spec for artists/composers.

music/zone_1.spec: 110 BPM, C Major, steel-pan/marimba/ukulele, 32 s loop, loop at beat 32

music/zone_1_fast.spec: 120 BPM version of zone_1; same arrangement, shakers more prominent

music/zone_2.spec: 125 BPM, E Dorian, nylon guitar/alto flute/cello pizz, 30.72 s loop

music/zone_2_fast.spec: 140 BPM version of zone_2; add hand drum on off-beats

music/zone_3.spec: 135 BPM, D Minor/Dorian, accordion/tin-whistle/bodhrán, 28.44 s loop

music/zone_3_fast.spec: 152 BPM version of zone_3; brass stabs every 2 bars

music/zone_4.spec: 155 BPM, F# Minor, distorted bass/taiko/brass swells, 24.52 s loop

music/zone_4_fast.spec: 175 BPM version of zone_4; add snare rolls every 4 bars

music/zone_5.spec: Variable 80-165 BPM per z5_tempo_curve.json, ambient/atmospheric, ≥120 s, no hard loop (plays once)

music/zone_6.spec: 175 BPM, A Minor pentatonic, choral/crystal-synth/marimba, 27.43 s loop

music/zone_6_fast.spec: 195 BPM version of zone_6; add rapid arpeggiated synth

music/main_menu.spec: Gentle 90 BPM ambient loop, calm underwater feel, ≥30 s

music/results_win.spec: 8-12 s celebratory fanfare, resolves the zone's key

music/results_fail.spec: 3-4 s gentle 'aww' sting, C minor, child-safe disappointment

sfx/timing_perfect.spec: High bright chord burst 880+1109+1319 Hz, <0.3 s

sfx/fever_start.spec: Rising two-note synth flourish 0.4 s, energetic

sfx/checkpoint_set.spec: Soft 'pop' or flag plant sound 0.2 s

sfx/coin_collect.spec: Short bright jingle 0.2 s, child-safe delight

sprite/player/default.spec: 56×56 px PNG, idle frame of Pebble the round blue fish, transparent bg

sprite/player/zap.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Zap the yellow electric fish

sprite/player/pip.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Pip the tiny pink fish

sprite/player/crusher.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Crusher the armored crab-fish

sprite/player/finn.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Finn the sleek silver fish

sprite/player/lumina.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Lumina the bioluminescent jellyfish-fish

sprite/player/mochi.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Mochi the round puffer fish

sprite/player/grumble.spec: 56×56 px PNG, Grumble the grumpy anglerfish

sprite/obstacle/coral_spike.spec: 60×variable px, sharp coral spike pointing up, transparent sides

sprite/obstacle/jellyfish.spec: 80×80 px PNG, rounded jellyfish body with tentacles, animated 4-frame

sprite/obstacle/kelp_blade.spec: 32×120 px PNG, single kelp blade, slightly tapered toward top

sprite/obstacle/bubble_mine.spec: 112×112 px PNG, round mine with spikes, 2 states (idle/warning)

sprite/collectible/treasure_coin.spec: 40×40 px PNG, gold coin with coral motif

sfx/power_charge.spec: Rising 3-note arpeggio 440→659→880 Hz, <0.4 s, charge-filling ping

sfx/power_fire.spec: Bright whoosh + pop 600 Hz base, <0.3 s, forward-motion launch feel

sfx/shield_break.spec: Glass-shatter reverb 800 Hz burst, <0.4 s, protective bubble pop

sprite/power/bubble_burst.spec: 48×48 px PNG, glowing teal bubble with rightward motion lines, transparent bg

sprite/power/echo_shield.spec: 48×48 px PNG, cyan ring/shield glyph with inner glow, transparent bg

sprite/power/magnet_pulse.spec: 48×48 px PNG, horseshoe magnet with attraction arc lines, transparent bg

sprite/power/beat_dash.spec: 48×48 px PNG, lightning bolt overlapping a music note, transparent bg

sprite/power/phase_bubble.spec: 48×48 px PNG, ghost bubble with dashed outline and alpha fade, transparent bg

sprite/ghost/trail.spec: 48×48 px PNG, translucent teal silhouette of the player fish, alpha ≤0.4, no outline
